# moonrepo

> > moonrepo provides moon (a Rust-based task runner and monorepo management tool) and proto (a multi-language version manager) for developer productivity in web ecosystems.

The platform supports JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Bun, Deno, Python, Go, PHP, Ruby, and other languages with intelligent caching, dependency graphs, and toolchain management. Moon v2 introduces WASM plugins and enhanced multi-language support.

## Key Topics

- moon task runner
- proto version manager
- monorepo management
- task configuration and dependency graphs
- incremental builds and caching
- toolchain configuration
- Node.js, Bun, Deno support
- TypeScript project references
- Python, Go, PHP, Ruby toolchains
- WASM plugins
- CI/CD integration
- package.json integration
- moon CLI commands
- workspace configuration
- developer productivity optimization

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://moonrepo.dev/docs): Main documentation entry point for moon v2 and proto tooling platform
- [moonrepo Platform](https://moonrepo.dev): Homepage introducing moonrepo's productivity platform with moon & proto
- [moon Task Runner](https://moonrepo.dev/moon): Moon product page highlighting Rust-based task runner features
- [How it works](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/how-it-works): Architecture overview covering project/task/action graphs in moon v2
- [Install moon](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/install): Installation guide for moon binary across platforms using proto
- [Setup toolchain](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/setup-toolchain): Configure moon's toolchain for automatic language version management
- [Create a task](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/create-task): Guide to defining and configuring tasks in moon.yml for projects
- [Run a task](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/run-task): Guide to executing tasks with moon run command and dependency graph

## Configuration Reference

- [Config files](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/config): Configuration file reference for workspace, toolchains, tasks & extensions
- [Concepts](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/concepts): Index of core concepts: affected, cache, file groups, tasks, toolchain
- [Tasks](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/concepts/task): Task concept reference: IDs, types, modes, and configuration options
- [CLI Commands Overview](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/commands/overview): CLI commands overview with global options, caching, and logging config
- [task command](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/commands/task): CLI reference for moon task command to inspect task configuration
- [template command](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/commands/template): CLI reference for moon template command to display template info
- [Supported tools (proto)](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/proto/tools): List of built-in and third-party tools supported by proto toolchain

## Language Handbooks

- [Node.js handbook](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/guides/javascript/node-handbook): Comprehensive Node.js monorepo setup guide with moon toolchain config
- [Bun handbook](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/guides/javascript/bun-handbook): Bun monorepo handbook covering toolchain and package manager setup
- [TypeScript project references](https://moonrepo.dev/docs/guides/javascript/typescript-project-refs): In-depth guide for using TypeScript project references in monorepos
